text:
maria: Quick heads-up — saw a perf regression on the AWQ INT8 weight-only path for 7B chat models in staging after the runtime change last night. p50 up ~20-30% on small-batch single-turn traffic.
aj: Ack. Any flamegraphs or traces yet?
maria: Not full flamegraphs yet. Quick profile shows kernel selector preferring awq.kernel_v2 for several layers; packer/unpack overhead increased.
kevin: Any change to default group_size or pack stride in that commit? I remember r1234 modified buffer alignment heuristics.
sasha: I ran a tiny microbench just now — group_size=64 gives slightly better quant error but adds ~0.8ms of pack/unpack vs group_size=32. For small batches that overhead dominates.
priya: Can we try dynamic per-layer group-size? Small linear layers could use 32, large matmuls 64. We had a prototype last quarter that picked group_size by row-variance.
maria: That would help. Selector currently only considers dtype and shape. I can add per-layer metadata hints (calib_quality, pack_cost_estimate) if folks agree.
aj: perf-bot, kick off bisect jobs comparing r1229 (pre-change) and r1234 (post-change) for pack-latency microbench.
perf-bot: Started jobs: pack-latency/2790012345-r1229 and pack-latency/2790012345-r1234. ETA ~15m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/packs/2790012345
kevin: Quick trace excerpt from the profiler I ran locally:
```
Layer 03: awq.kernel_v2  time=2.80ms  pack+unpack=1.10ms  kvcache=0.20ms
Layer 04: gptq.kernel     time=1.90ms  pack+unpack=0.30ms  kvcache=0.15ms
Layer 05: awq.kernel_v2  time=2.60ms  pack+unpack=0.95ms  kvcache=0.18ms
Total p50: 14.2ms -> 18.6ms after r1234 (single-turn, bs=1, seq=32)
```
sasha: Looks like awq.kernel_v2 does more unpack/staging work; possibly a different staging buffer alignment or an extra memcpy path.
priya: Regression is amplified at batch_size=1. With microbatching (bs>1) the amortized pack cost drops and the regression is smaller. We should penalize pack overhead in the cost model for small-batch latency SLOs.
aj: Proposed action list: 1) maria add per-layer selector hints + expose pack_cost metric 2) kevin instrument packer to emit alignment/memcpy stats 3) sasha run group_size sweep (16/32/64/128) across 4 random seeds and publish quality vs latency 4) priya add small-batch penalty to kernel cost model. I'll file a tracking ticket.
maria: I'll open the PR for selector metadata + add a mini-benchmark harness in eng-ml/test/perf. Pinging @kevin for pack instrumentation.
kevin: On it. I'll add counters for "pack_bytes_aligned", "pack_memcpy_calls", and a timing histogram. Will push a perf patch later today and dump a heap trace.
perf-bot: pack-latency/2790012345-r1229 completed: p50=14.1ms p95=43ms. pack-latency/2790012345-r1234 completed: p50=18.9ms p95=67ms. Regression confirmed :chart_with_downwards_trend:. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/packs/2790012345/results
maria: Thanks — rolling a canary rollback to r1229 on dedicated for 12h to limit customer impact.
sasha: We should also consider a quick hybrid-fallback: if predicted pack+unpack > threshold for bs=1/seq<=32, fallback to gptq.kernel which has lower pack cost. That buys us time while we tune group_size selection.
aj: Agreed. Keep updates here. I'll create the ticket and assign items. :thumbsup:
maria: Noted, will follow up with PR link and narrow perf numbers.
kevin: Will post instrumentation numbers and a patch set by EOD.
perf-bot: Note: jobs and logs are archived under infra/perf/2790012345 for future triage.
aj: Thanks everyone — please add any additional observations here.
